subject: MAP: POC environment checklist & activation grid
messages:
From: James Porter <james.porter@medent.health>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medent.health
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: MAP and environment checklist for POC

Hi Laura / Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed. We want to make sure the Mutual Action Plan captures the environment steps we need to complete before our procurement review. At a minimum we need: org setup (admin account + service account), API key provisioning and rotation policy, IP allowlist for your hosted endpoints, and the option for VPC peering if the production evaluation goes that route.

Can you send a single checklist (owners + estimated days) we can share with Security and Procurement? Procurement will also need any compliance evidence references.

Thanks,
James Porter
Head of Platform Integrations
MedEnt Health

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: James Porter <james.porter@medent.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP and environment checklist for POC

Hi James — appreciate the quick follow-up. Attached is a first-pass MAP action grid (MAP-action-grid-v1.xlsx) and a short list of the IP ranges we expect customers to allow for Redwood hosted inference endpoints (medent-ip-list.txt). High level summary below (owners & rough lead time):

- Org setup: Redwood creates a customer org shell and provisions 1 admin user + 1 service account for POC. Owner: laura_bennett@redwood.com. Time: 1 business day once we have the admin email.
- API keys: We issue scoped API keys tied to the service account for the POC. Owner: laura_bennett + karthik_iyer. Time: same day; recommend rotation window of 30 days for evaluation.
- IP allowlist: Please add the ranges in the attached medent-ip-list.txt to your firewall for outbound requests to our API. Owner: MedEnt Networking. Time: 1–3 business days depending on change control.
- VPC peering (optional): If you want private traffic, we can open a peering request. Technical pre-reqs listed in the attachment; owner: karthik_iyer. Time: 5–10 business days (cloud vendor dependent).

Next steps: 1) Confirm admin email for org shell, 2) Accept attached MAP and return any procurement-specific requirements, 3) If you want peering, indicate region and cloud account IDs and we will kick off network design.

Attaching: MAP-action-grid-v1.xlsx, medent-ip-list.txt

Best,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, James Porter <james.porter@medent.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP and environment checklist for POC

James / Laura — a few technical clarifications to avoid re-work:

1) API keys & scopes: For the evaluation we will provide a read/write scoped API key tied to a service account that can be limited to the evaluation model. We support per-route scoping and request rate limits; if you prefer token-based short-lived credentials we can also issue ephemeral tokens via our auth endpoint (requires a small client integration).

2) IP allowlist specifics: The attached medent-ip-list.txt contains both public egress ranges for the region we demoed and an ASN-backed fallback. Please allow both.

3) VPC peering notes: If you choose peering, we require a peering subnet that does not overlap with our internal CIDRs and a cross-account role for routing validation. I'll attach a simple diagram (vpc-peering-diagram.png) with the expected route table changes. Cloud vendor approval (internal change control) is often the critical path — plan for 7 business days for the network team to complete both sides.

4) Test token rotation: For the POC we suggest a 30-day rotation; for production we recommend 7–14 days. We will provide a small helper script to automate rotation in your CI if helpful.

Happy to jump on a 30-minute technical call to walk your infra team through the steps.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Subject: Re: MAP and environment checklist for POC

Looping in timeline and procurement touches from our side. Quick operational plan (2-week POC cadence):

Week 0 (kickoff): confirm admin account + sign MAP (DocuSign link below).
Week 1: org shell + API keys provisioned; IP allowlist verification (external test).
Week 2: optional VPC peering testing OR full traffic validation against hosted endpoints; final acceptance run and handoff to your SREs.

Procurement note: If your team needs SOC2 artifacts or a data processing addendum, please send procurement@medent.health the request and we will attach the artifacts to the HubSpot record. I put a quick DocuSign placeholder here for your legal team to review: https://www.docusign.com/rooms/medent-map-agreement

Attachments referenced above are in our shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b-MAP-Latest
